papers.title: Fabrication of Al-2.5Fe binary alloy by selective laser melting
papers.venue: the Japan Society of Powder and Powder Metallurgy

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究选择性激光熔化制备铝铁合金，与生物医学植入物方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is about SLM of Al-Fe alloy for non-biomedical applications, with no porous structure, no mechanical testing for implants, no fatigue, no osseointegration, and no patient-specific considerations.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM工艺制备Al-2.5Fe合金的可行性。
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化技术制备Al-2.5Fe合金试样。
summary_zh.result: 成功制备出致密的Al-2.5Fe合金，并表征了其微观结构和力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过金相观察和力学测试验证了合金的成形质量。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the feasibility of fabricating Al-2.5Fe binary alloy via selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Al-2.5Fe alloy samples were fabricated using selective laser melting and characterized for microstructure and mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: Dense Al-2.5Fe alloy samples were successfully produced with reported microstructural and mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through metallographic observation and mechanical testing of the fabricated samples.

papers.title: Effect of HIP on Defect and Fatigue Strength of Inconel 718 Fabricated by Selective Laser Melting
papers.venue: the Japan Society of Powder and Powder Metallurgy

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究镍基高温合金而非生物医用材料，未涉及多孔结构或应力遮挡。
llm.why_not_core: This paper investigates Inconel 718 for aerospace applications, not biomedical implants; no porous structure, stress shielding, stiffness matching, or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热等静压对选区激光熔化Inconel 718缺陷与疲劳强度的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对SLM成型Inconel 718进行HIP处理，测试疲劳性能并观察缺陷。
summary_zh.result: HIP可减少内部缺陷，提升疲劳强度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过疲劳实验与断口分析验证HIP效果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of hot isostatic pressing on defect density and fatigue strength of Inconel 718 fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: SLM-fabricated Inconel 718 specimens were subjected to HIP treatment, then fatigue-tested and defect-characterized.
summary_en.result: HIP significantly reduced internal defects and improved fatigue strength compared to as-built condition.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed via fatigue testing and fractographic analysis.

papers.title: Invited Talk : Effects of HIP process on characteristics of Ni Alloy 718 fabricated by Selective laser melting.
papers.venue: the Japan Society of Powder and Powder Metallurgy

llm.relevance_to_user: 与用户研究方向无关，未涉及生物医学植入物或应力遮挡问题。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structure or stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, and no surface roughness or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究热等静压工艺对选区激光熔化Ni合金718特性的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对比HIP处理前后材料的微观结构与力学性能。
summary_zh.result: HIP处理改善了材料致密度和力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和微观分析验证。

summary_en.motivation: Investigate the effects of hot isostatic pressing on the characteristics of Ni alloy 718 fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Comparison of microstructure and mechanical properties before and after HIP treatment.
summary_en.result: HIP treatment improved density and mechanical properties of the alloy.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and microstructure analysis were used for validation.

papers.title: Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of Ni based superalloy IN718 Fabricated by Selective Laser Melting in High Vacuum Atmosphere
papers.venue: Japan Society of Powder and Powder Metallurgy

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是航空用镍基高温合金IN718的选区激光熔化工艺与力学性能，与生物医学方向的应力遮挡、多孔植入物或骨整合无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on a nickel-based superalloy for aerospace applications and does not address biomedical implant design, stress shielding, porous structures, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究高真空环境下选区激光熔化制备IN718合金的显微组织与力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用高真空SLM工艺制备IN718样品，通过SEM、EBSD等表征微观结构并进行拉伸测试。
summary_zh.result: 获得了致密的IN718合金，其力学性能与传统工艺相当或更优。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸试验和微观结构观察验证了工艺的可行性。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of high vacuum atmosphere during selective laser melting on the microstructure and mechanical properties of IN718 superalloy.
summary_en.method: IN718 specimens were fabricated by SLM under high vacuum, and characterized using SEM, EBSD, and tensile testing.
summary_en.result: Fully dense IN718 with mechanical properties comparable to or better than conventionally processed material was obtained.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and microstructural analysis confirmed the effectiveness of the high vacuum SLM process.

papers.title: Fatigue properties in hot isostatically pressed Al-10%Si-0.4%Mg alloy fabricated by selective laser melting
papers.venue: Japan Society of Powder and Powder Metallurgy

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究铝合金的疲劳性能，不涉及生物医学植入物或骨整合，与用户研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant materials, stress shielding, stiffness matching, osseointegration, or surface roughness; it focuses on an aluminum alloy unsuitable for biomedical use.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制备的Al-Si-Mg合金经HIP后的疲劳性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备试样并进行HIP处理，然后进行疲劳测试。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the fatigue properties of Al-10%Si-0.4%Mg alloy fabricated by SLM after HIP.
summary_en.method: Specimens were fabricated by SLM, subjected to HIP, and then fatigue tests were performed.
summary_en.result: HIP treatment improved fatigue life compared to as-built condition.
